title: Recovery Robustness vs Fine-Tuning: How Fast Does Cheap Tuning Strip Deep Alignment?

original_idea.body: Apply small benign LoRA fine-tunes for increasing steps to a deep-alignment open model and after each checkpoint measure prefill-recovery robustness, plotting how rapidly recovery degrades.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: dose-response of alignment fragility under cheap LoRA tuning is a concrete open-weight tampering risk.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: LoRA fine-tuning checkpoints + prefill-recovery eval; intermediate, requires a training loop.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open-weight tampering robustness labs underweight, open models.

low_compute.reasoning: LoRA on 7B is borderline but feasible on one consumer GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Fine-tuning strips safety established; dose-response of deep-alignment recovery may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: This dose-response of prefill-recovery may be open.
